description: Previously inspected cases used for development. All eight demonstration cases excluded, even from zero-shot control.

department.description: Route by the main requested action: billing for charges, invoices, refunds; technical for broken product functionality or outages; account_access for login, password, or account access; sales for pre-purchase pricing or feature questions. Explicitly prioritize the main request over background context.

refund_requested.description: Does the customer explicitly ask to return or reverse money already paid? A denied, negated, hypothetical, or historical refund request is false.

production_outage.description: Does the message report that the production service is currently unavailable? Past resolved outages, staging/test failures, login problems for one user, and hypothetical outages are false.

phone_call_requested.description: Does the customer explicitly request a phone call or live telephone bridge? Email replies, past calls, and explicitly rejecting calls are false.

priority.description: urgent if there is a current production outage OR the customer explicitly requests action immediately/today, or states a deadline today. Otherwise normal. A negated urgency or hypothetical deadline does not count.
